item.title: About JCL Travel
item.description:
About JCL Travel

Opening the Door to China for Our Overseas Colleagues

Our Story

At JCL Travel, we believe travel is about connection, discovery, and transformation.

Founded with a passion for sharing the real China with the world, we noticed that many international travelers were missing out on authentic Chinese experiences, often limited to crowded tourist sites and standardized tours.

We set out to change that by creating tour packages that go beyond the surface, connecting travelers with local communities, traditions, and landscapes that make China truly special.

item.title: Beijing Imperial Capital Tour
Chongqing & Yangtze River Gateway
Shanghai Modern Metropolis Tour
item.description:
Tour Overview

Discover Shanghai, China’s most dynamic city where East meets West in spectacular fashion. This 5-day tour takes you from ancient water towns to futuristic skyscrapers, showcasing the incredible diversity of this global metropolis.

Perfect for first-time visitors and repeat travelers alike, our Shanghai tour offers a balanced mix of must-see attractions and authentic local experiences.

Detailed Itinerary

Day 1: Arrival in Shanghai

  • Airport pickup and transfer to your hotel in central Shanghai
  • Welcome briefing with your guide over traditional Chinese tea
  • Evening at leisure to recover from travel or explore your neighborhood
  • Accommodation: 4-star hotel in People’s Square area

Day 2: Historic Shanghai & The Bund

  • Morning: Visit Yu Garden and the adjacent Old City God Temple area
  • Lunch: Authentic Shanghai soup dumplings (Xiaolongbao) at a local restaurant
  • Afternoon: Explore the historic Bund waterfront with its colonial architecture
  • Evening: Huangpu River cruise with stunning views of Pudong’s skyline
  • Dinner: Welcome dinner featuring Shanghai cuisine

Day 3: French Concession & Modern Art

  • Morning: Walking tour through the charming French Concession
  • Visit: Tianzifang arts and crafts enclave
  • Lunch: Fusion cuisine in Xintiandi
  • Afternoon: Shanghai Museum (private guided tour)
  • Evening: Optional acrobatics show or free time for shopping

Day 4: Pudong & Future Shanghai

  • Morning: Visit the Shanghai Tower observation deck (632 meters)
  • Experience: Traditional Chinese tea ceremony
  • Lunch: Modern Chinese cuisine with Pudong skyline views
  • Afternoon: Shanghai Urban Planning Exhibition Center
  • Evening: Farewell dinner at a revolving restaurant

Day 5: Departure or Extension

  • Morning: Visit Zhujiajiao water town (optional)
  • Afternoon: Transfer to airport for departure
  • Extension options: Add days for Suzhou, Hangzhou, or Beijing

Tour Highlights

🏛️ Cultural Immersion

  • Private guided tour of Shanghai Museum’s best collections
  • Traditional tea ceremony with tea master
  • Walking tour through historic neighborhoods

🏙️ Architectural Wonders

  • The Bund’s colonial buildings contrasted with Pudong’s futuristic skyline
  • French Concession’s tree-lined avenues and art deco buildings
  • Shanghai Tower - China’s tallest building

🍜 Culinary Experiences

  • Authentic Shanghai soup dumplings cooking demonstration
  • Huangpu River cruise dinner
  • Local market visit and food tasting

🛍️ Shopping Opportunities

  • Nanjing Road - China’s premier shopping street
  • Tianzifang arts and crafts district
  • Xintiandi’s boutique shops

Accommodation

Standard Package

4-star hotel in central Shanghai (People’s Square or Nanjing Road area)

item.title: Xi'an Ancient Capital & Terracotta Army
item.description:
Tour Overview

Journey to Xi’an, the starting point of the Silk Road and home to the incredible Terracotta Army. This 4-day tour immerses you in ancient Chinese history while enjoying modern comforts.

Quick Facts

  • Duration: 4 days / 3 nights
  • Price: From $980 per person
  • Difficulty: Easy
  • Best time: March-June, September-November
  • Group size: 2-12 travelers

Itinerary Highlights

Day 1: Arrival & City Wall

  • Airport transfer and hotel check-in
  • Cycle or walk on the Ancient City Wall
  • Explore the Muslim Quarter
  • Dinner featuring Shaanxi cuisine

Day 2: Terracotta Army

  • Full-day visit to the Terracotta Army Museum
  • Private tour with archaeology expert
  • Visit the tomb of Emperor Qin Shi Huang
  • Evening Tang Dynasty music and dance show

Day 3: Historical Xi’an

  • Visit Big Wild Goose Pagoda
  • Shaanxi History Museum
  • Calligraphy lesson with local master
  • Free evening for shopping or relaxation

Day 4: Departure

  • Visit local market for souvenirs
  • Transfer to airport for departure

Book Your Ancient Adventure

Contact us to experience the wonders of ancient China.

item.title: Xinjiang Silk Road Adventure
item.description:
Tour Overview

Explore China’s western frontier, where Central Asian cultures meet stunning natural landscapes. This 10-day adventure follows the ancient Silk Road through Xinjiang’s deserts, mountains, and oasis cities.

Quick Facts

  • Duration: 10 days / 9 nights
  • Price: From $2,200 per person
  • Difficulty: Moderate (some long drives, altitude changes)
  • Best time: May-October
  • Group size: 4-10 travelers

Itinerary Highlights

Days 1-3: Urumqi & Heavenly Lake

  • Arrival in Urumqi, Xinjiang’s capital
  • Visit Tianchi (Heavenly Lake)
  • Xinjiang Regional Museum
  • Local Uyghur restaurant experience

Days 4-6: Turpan & Ancient Cities

  • Journey to Turpan, China’s hottest city
  • Visit ancient cities of Jiaohe and Gaochang
  • Karez underground irrigation system
  • Grape Valley and local vineyard visit

Days 7-10: Kashgar & Silk Road

  • Flight to Kashgar
  • Explore Kashgar Old City
  • Sunday Market - largest in Central Asia
  • Karakul Lake with views of Muztagh Ata
  • Farewell dinner with Uyghur family

Experience the Silk Road

Contact us for this unique adventure through China’s western frontier.
